name: Sprinkles Icecream
description: An Elkins Park ice cream shop serving hand-scooped flavors, sundaes, and cold treats for the whole family.

hero.headline: Sprinkles Icecream
hero.sub: Scoops, sundaes, and cold treats made for a quick stop or a slow summer evening.

items: Hand-scooped ice cream in a rotating lineup of classic and seasonal flavors
Sundaes, shakes, and toppings bars built for kids and adults alike
Take-home pints for the freezer when the craving hits later
A neighborhood stop in Elkins Park for cones, cups, and sundaes
Flavor lineup rotates with the season
Easy in-and-out counter service, no reservation needed
A regular stop for families after dinner or a walk around town

story.heading: About
paragraphs: Sprinkles Icecream keeps things simple: real ice cream, generous scoops, and a counter that moves fast on a hot afternoon.
It is the kind of stop a neighborhood builds a routine around -- after Little League, after dinner, or just because.

items: Walk up, pick a flavor, and get a scoop without a long wait.
Ask about the daily flavor lineup -- it changes with the season.
Bring the whole family; there is something for every age at the counter.

feature.heading: Hand-scooped, not soft-serve
feature.text: Every cone and cup starts with real hand-scooped ice cream -- the kind that holds its shape and its flavor.

spotlight.heading: Sundaes and shakes worth the trip
spotlight.text: Build a sundae with classic toppings or go straight for a thick shake -- either way, it is a treat worth the drive.
